title: Indus-script find sites from the 2026-10-06 evidence census
status: Exploratory. Values are copied from census rows; coordinates are never added here.

field_notes.coord_status: census-verified: numeric point accepted in the row; census-partial: the row marks the point as a proxy, area centroid or locality, or (Bet Dwarka) the point is the centroid of a published bounding box; census-candidate-unresolved: only an unaccepted candidate exists, kept in candidate_lat/candidate_lon or candidate_points; missing: no point in any row.
field_notes.fieldwork: Events parsed from excavation_campaigns. parse=override marks hand-curated entries (see CAMPAIGN_OVERRIDES in the script). 'years' is the row's text verbatim.
field_notes.first_fieldwork_year: Earliest start_year among discovery, survey, excavation and other events that count for the first year. If only a report year is earlier or available, it is used with first_fieldwork_upper_bound=true.
field_notes.counts: Copied per row, not reconciled. B-batch ICIT values count legible sign occurrences, not objects.
field_notes.dating_notes: stratum_or_phase and absolute_dates entries whose availability is yes or partial, text verbatim. Most describe what dating metadata a source offers; a few state a period or BCE range. D-batch rows keep the text in the locator field, so text and locator are the same string.
field_notes.batch: Batch of the primary row; merged entities list every contributing batch in `batches`.
